imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The medicine-ball guide uses three accurate Amazon category text links; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: Five homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.4, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap snapshot showed 26 URLs and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The homepage-only sample is too small for a Data-led item. The batch therefore creates one authority asset and two unrelated purchase-intent explorations while strengthening consumer recovery, fitness equipment and practical taste clusters plus their crawl paths.
searchConsole.ignored: The five homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant, aggregate position and stale 26-submitted/zero-indexed sitemap snapshot were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting or title changes; the discovery snapshot instead supports stronger hubs, reciprocal links, Library coverage and sitemap paths.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the medicine-ball guide. The crash-file and coffee-grinder guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy post-crash safety, evidence, notification, estimate, payment and closure control file that separates emergency action from claim administration and preserves jurisdiction-specific reporting boundaries.
authority.cluster: Consumer recovery and vehicle ownership, with reciprocal paths from auto-insurance review, roadside planning, repair-estimate control and rental-car handoff; the other pages strengthen evidence-aware fitness equipment and coffee workflow.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for NAIC consumer education and state insurance-department outreach; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life and Fitness: what to preserve after a car crash, which medicine-ball format fits a specific training task, and which coffee-grinder design fits an existing brewer. Only the fitness guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
